notes.title: Soulknight Survivor v.1.056
notes.content: [p]If you’re just here for the patchnotes, feel free to scroll down.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s been a long time since the last update, and I want to be honest with you...[/p][p]For the past few months, I wasn’t even sure if I’d finish this one.[/p][p]I’m someone with a lot of dreams, and one of them was to release a game on Steam. That dream came true, and it’s been a great experience—not just from a game design perspective, but also in learning so much more about the industry as a whole.[/p][p]First of all, I want to thank everyone who joined me on this journey and enjoyed Soulknight Survivor. I'm not a professional developer, but I genuinely enjoyed improving the game bit by bit based on the constructive feedback I received.[/p][p]That said, I’m still working full-time as a mechanic, so I can’t continue developing this project indefinitely.[/p][p]I hope this final update (or maybe more... if I feel a scribble in my fingers again 😄) addresses a lot of the issues—especially for those who didn’t enjoy the grindier parts of the game.[/p][p]Since this update took quite a while, I want to go a bit deeper into the reasoning behind some of the changes:[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Quest System[/b][/p][p]To be honest, I have no idea why I thought this was a great idea a year ago—it took so much time to implement, and I’m definitely not the best story writer 😅[/p][p]Still, I hope it brings a few smiles here and there.[/p][p]Each map now has a questline. For every quest you complete, you gain +3% Soulpower damage. This should help make things a bit easier as you progress.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1005598907012759613/1370537724293152808/Screenshot_2025-05-10_005922.png?ex=68569278&is=685540f8&hm=3c79a594bd26dd20a8ab352e5e4cd27500163127777510d8770273addb4209d1&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1292&height=726"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Spears Are Now Throwing Weapons[/b][/p][p]Let’s face it—spears never really held up against swords. Making them longer or increasing their reach didn’t help much either.[/p][p]So why not turn them into throwing weapons and offer a real alternative to the already solid melee option?[/p][p][/p][p][b]Weapon Charge Slowdown[/b][/p][p]I know a lot of you disliked the slowdown when charging your weapon, so I reduced it even further.[/p][p]And with the mastery now working correctly, it’s actually possible to completely eliminate the slowdown.[/p][p]Yes, you heard that right—you can now play with zero slowdown while charging your weapon.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Lower Base HP for Early Enemies[/b][/p][p]Originally, the game was built with hardcore, grind-focused players in mind. But as I’ve learned more about modern game design, I realized that a smoother, more welcoming early experience is important.[/p][p]This change should help streamline things a bit more.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Max Resource Changes[/b][/p][p]It simply wasn’t fun to feel forced into upgrading your home just to collect basic resources.[/p][p]So the starting max resource cap has been increased from 200 to 500, and each home upgrade now gives +250 instead of just 100.[/p][p][/p][p][b]More Souls[/b][/p][p]Souls dropped have been doubled, which also means your Soulpower bar fills faster.[/p][p]This is another change aimed at making the game more accessible.[/p][p]And it also makes the Soulpower Level cap mastery more meaningful—since now you’ll actually reach those higher levels more often.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you like the changes, have fun! :D[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Patchnotes[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added: Each level now contains 8–10 quests. Completing a quest increases your Soulpower damage by 3% per quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed: GameMaker runtime upgraded to 2024.13.0.238 for improved performance and compatibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed: Scribble extension has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed: Spears have been reworked into throwing weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed: The "Reset Savegame" option in the settings menu now requires confirmation to prevent accidental data loss.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed: Reduced the base slowdown while charging your weapon (without mastery) from 60% to 70% of the default speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed: Lowered the base HP of many early-game enemies to smooth out initial difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed: Starting Max Resource increased from 200 to 500.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed: Upgrading your home now increases Max Resource by 250 (up from 100).[/p][/*][*][p]Changed: Steamworks SDK upgraded to v1.61.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed: The number of souls dropped has been doubled, making progression faster and more rewarding.[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: Heal Mastery only worked when "Healing aura" Soulpower was active.[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: Fixed an error where the slowdown mastery actually increased slowdown instead of decreasing it.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Soulknight Survivor v.1.054
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Deleted the "auto-aim on/off" description from the gamepad controls window, as it is not usable anymore since v.1.51 on gamepad.
[*] Bushes now have a Z-Level, so they can be drawn above or below the player based on the player's position on the y-axis.
[*] Added the missing bushes/grass from the last update to be destroyable.
[*] Added a sound when a bomb is activated by the player.
[*] Updated ppfx (graphical effects library) to the recent version.
[*] Bugfix: Destroyable bushes were always drawn above the player in the village.
[*] Bugfix: Addressed the bug with the flash soul power again. Hopefully, it's truly fixed this time.
[*] Bugfix: Background of the speech bubbles was not drawn correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Soulknight Survivor v.1.053
notes.content:
[list]
[*] All texts are now rendered by the newly implemented Scribble extension. Hope everything looks crisp now :)
[*] Several (now unneeded) fonts were deleted, which should decrease texture pages and improve performance.
[*] Added some missing translations.
[*] Bushes are now slashable. What do they drop? Nothing, but it's fun xD
[*] Bugfix: Fixed a bug that occurred when the flash soulpower followed an enemy out of sight.
[*] Some minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Soulknight Survivor v.1.052
notes.content:
This update is a follow-up to the last update. I'm currently working on migrating most of the texts to the newly implemented Scribble text rendering extension.

[list]
[*] The SE-Development logo is now loaded as a graphic instead of a font to save texture page memory.
[*] Adjusted the vertical position of several windows to be more central.
[*] Added some missing translations.
[*] Replaced several texts with "Scribble" text rendering to make them more readable and dynamic.
[*] The item name in the chest window now shrinks to fit the window width if it's too long.
[*] Added stat change numbers to the chest window, making it easier to decide if you want to scrap an item.
[*] Bugfix: In the chest window, it was not possible to select "scrap" for ring items.
[/list]

notes.title: Soulknight Survivor v.1.051
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Migration from GameMaker LTS to the recent version, as the long-term support version had become outdated. Please report any bugs encountered, as updates like this can potentially cause issues.
[*] Updated the "Input" library/extension (by Juju Adams and Alynne Keith) to the latest version.
[*] Implemented the text rendering extension "Scribble" by Juju Adams. Currently, it's only in use by the crafting and skill window, but there are plans to expand its usage further.
[*] The font can now be changed within the language file by entering the name of the desired font. Make sure the font file is in the same folder as the language files.
[*] Since auto-aim can now be interrupted on a gamepad by using the right stick, the auto-aim toggle button on the gamepad is now disabled.
[*] Settings are now not saved anymore when activating or deactivating auto-aim but instead at the end of the game.
[*] Bugfix: Resolved a resolution issue that could wash out the graphics.
[*] Bugfix: Removed numbers behind the item name after crafting, which were a relic of the old rarity system.
[*] Bugfix: Names of crafted items now shrink down to fit in the result box of the crafting window.
[*] Bugfix: Fixed an issue where the first random encounter always appeared after 10 seconds due to testing settings not being randomized again.
[*] Some minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Soulknight Survivor v.1.050
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Auto-aim on gamepad is now always on but can be disrupted by manually aiming (using the right axis).
[*] Auto-aim now also targets activatable bombs on the ground.
[*] Ice ghosts are now slightly slower.
[*] Storm sound volume has been decreased.
[*] Shop sell sound volume has been increased.
[*] Step traps now reset after a while.
[*] Healing rain spawns one more cloud and heals double the HP.
[*] Hitbox of the flame bullets has been slightly decreased.
[*] Added some missing translations.
[*] Bugfix: Portals didn't spawn properly since the last patch.
[*] Some minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Soulknight Survivor v.1.049
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Portals now automatically close after 4 minutes.
[*] Reduced the number of bomb cycles at the bombrain event, balancing the gameplay.
[*] Introduced a new random event: Healing rain. (finally rain that I enjoy) ;)
[*] Implemented a feature where the game pauses when the gamepad is unplugged, ensuring a smoother player experience.
[*] Reduced the size of some maps for improved navigation and gameplay.
[*] The arrow indicating the direction of the minecart is now red for better visibility and clarity.
[*] Slightly increased the damage output of the player.
[*] Bugfix: Resolved the issue where it was possible to upgrade masteries above Level 5.
[*] Various small optimizations and bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Soulknight Survivor v.1.048
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Enhanced the visibility of the mastery button by making it blink slightly brighter.
[*] New mastery: Decrease weapon charge slowdown by 4%.
[*] New mastery: Increase the maximum Soulpower level by 5.
[*] Implemented a new level-up animation for added visual appeal.
[*] Replaced the "Back" and "Forward" buttons in the language selection and achievements window with arrow graphics.
[*] Modified the Soulpower magnet, reducing its levels to 5, aligning with most other passive soulpowers.
[*] Separated the "hold attack to charge" hint from the tutorial, now always appearing in the first two runs.
[*] Added the hint "you can level up with souls" on the map, displaying when the player accumulates enough souls for a level up.
[*] Adjusted the "Redeem" hint to align with the level-up hint.
[*] Introduced a new random event: Ghostring.
[*] Bugfix: Increased the possible text width of town buildings to enhance the visuals of translations.
[*] Bugfix: Resolved an error that could occur when loading the game with an old settings file containing new settings added in a newer version.
[*] Several performance optimizations.
[/list]

notes.title: Soulknight Survivor v.1.047
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Implemented a dynamic system for events (bombs, turrets, etc.) to appear randomly, introducing variety and excitement to each run. Bosses, however, remain fixed on a predetermined schedule.
[*] Introduced a new event: Soulimp, a creature not particularly dangerous and a bit shy, but it carries a substantial bag of souls.
[*] Introduced a new event: Storm. 
[*] Adjusted the timing of miniboss appearances to minutes 10 and 20, with the end boss now scheduled for minute 29:55. This shift aligns better with the progression of the level.
[*] The barricade now spawns at a random position and may contain 2-4 chests, with variations influenced in part by the luck stat.
[*] Chests from barricades can now include all chest ranks, influenced by the player's luck stat.
[*] Added a tutorial feature: When activated, a brief message blinks below the player at level start, reminding them to charge an attack by holding the attack button.
[*] Bugfix: Addressed a calculation issue with drop chances in the crafting window.
[*] Bugfix: Resolved an issue where, if the player dodged at the moment the soulpower window opened, it would immediately close.
[/list]

notes.title: Soulknight Survivor v.1.046
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Instead of blocking not unlocked difficulties from being selected in the difficulty selection window, they are now selected with red tint.
[*] Revamped the difficulty window to include a screenshot preview and a table detailing drop chances specific to the selected difficulty.
[*] Introduced two additional droptables for higher tiers, focusing on later levels and increased difficulties.
[*] Adjusted drop chances for achievement chests to enhance gameplay balance.
[*] Increased the effectiveness of the magnet soulpower for improved in-game benefits.
[*] The mastery button in the skill menu now blinks, providing a clearer indication of available mastery points to invest.
[*] Bugfix: Resolved an issue where levels on the world map couldn't be selected via the mouse following the last update.
[*] Bugfix: Corrected an error in the controls window, where it incorrectly displayed "dodge" instead of "autoaim on/off" for the middle mouse button.
[*] Bugfix: Rings are now included in the potential drops from achievement chests.
[*] Bugfix: Adjusted the hoverboxes of the "back" and "forward" buttons in the achievement window to ensure a proper interactive area.
[/list]


[b][i]The upgraded difficulty selection window[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44172758/e7deb74417c077f9ecd0411fa06121daf8c76f52.png[/img]

notes.title: Soulknight Survivor v.1.045
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Implemented "Input 6.1" by Juju Adams, replacing the previous input system. This update aims to enhance compatibility with a variety of existing gamepads by incorporating community-contributed bindings for commonly used controllers.
[*] Updated the visuals for the Xbox gamepad buttons. Additionally, introduced graphics for PlayStation controllers, with the system automatically displaying buttons based on the connected gamepad type.
[*] Revamped the controls window to align with the new Input system, including the addition of buttons for "show/hide fireplace" and "controls" to provide a comprehensive overview.
[*] Included keyboard keys "Q" and "E" for "show/hide fireplace" and "autoaim" in the controls window's keyboard section.
[*] Adjusted the controls window to dynamically display the relevant section instead of defaulting to the gamepad section upon opening.
[*] Changed the toggle autoaim command to the X button (square on PS gamepad) instead of A (X on PS gamepad).
[*] Enabled the use of A and B buttons (X and circle on PS gamepad) for attacking and dodging in addition to LB and RB.
[*] Implemented automatic showing/hiding of the mouse based on the input device in use, eliminating the need for the "always show mouse" setting.
[*] Updated the "Close" button to "Ok" during language selection at the first start for clarity.
[*] Bugfix: Resolved a bug where Townhall souls were erroneously credited when the game was paused.
[*] Bugfix: Increased the width of the "back" and "forward" buttons during language selection at the first start.
[*] Bugfix: Fixed a bug where autoaim could not be activated or deactivated in the hometown, potentially causing confusion.
[*] Bugfix: Addressed a bug that previously prevented aiming in the hometown with disabled autoaim, where the direction was consistently to the right, creating an odd visual effect.
[/list]

EDIT:
Hotfix to v.1.045: Fixed movement bug.

notes.title: Soulknight Survivor v.1.043
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The mouse is now automatically locked within the game screen, preventing accidental clicks outside the window.
[*] Introducing a new option in the settings menu: "Always show mouse." Enable this feature to keep your mouse visible even when a gamepad is detected.
[*] Corruption now initiates at a smaller size and gradually expands.
[*] Corruption is now capable of spreading, with a higher likelihood on increased difficulty settings.
[*] Collision mask of corruption slightly reduced for improved gameplay.
[*] New language option added: Spanish.
[/list]

notes.title: Soulknight Survivor v.1.042
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New Soulpower: Dark orb - Create up to two dark orbs that are hovering around you.
[*] Altered the visual appearance of the first button in the settings menu to explicitly convey its clickability, signaling its role in toggling between "game/audio/graphic" options.
[*] Reduced the invulnerability cooldown as well as the stun of the enemies when they got hit.
[*] Bugfix: The invulnerability cooldown and stun of some enemies had the old computation which was based on weapon damage stat.
[/list]

notes.title: Soulknight Survivor v.1.041
notes.content: Hotfix: Fixed the crash at farmlevels since last update.

notes.title: Soulknight Survivor v.1.040
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Slightly increased the radius of mighty slash.
[*] Adjusted the stamina consumption formula by reducing the impact of the item damage stat.
[*] Slightly increased the size of minibosses for a more imposing presence.
[*] Minibosses now emit a subtle red glow, enhancing their visibility.
[*] Flattened the progressive curve for souls required for skilling, making upgrades more accessible.
[*] Introduced informative text in the difficulty selection window detailing the bonus souls (+50% / +100% / +200%) for each difficulty level.
[*] Slightly reduced the hitboxes of corruption, bomb explosion, and blob enemy explosions for better gameplay precision.
[*] Implemented an indicator, similar to the ones for minibosses and chests, for the campfire. Activation is possible by pressing Q or left trigger A on the gamepad. The indicator turns on automatically upon completing a level, aiding particularly in Ironman mode for level exit navigation.
[/list]

notes.title: Soulknight Survivor v.1.039
notes.content:
First and foremost, I extend my heartfelt thanks to all of you for purchasing and playing Soulknight Survivor! As my debut project on Steam, the journey has been one of immense learning.

I want to emphasize that I value feedback, particularly when it is constructive and respectful. Many players expressed dissatisfaction with the RNG, especially concerning the random stats of items. I acknowledge that I may have pushed it a bit too far, and with this update, I aim to address these concerns and make the experience more enjoyable for most of you.

Let's delve into the issues and changes introduced in this update step by step (for those who prefer to read only the patch notes, please scroll to the bottom).

[b][u]Insufficient Equipment drops:[/u][/b]
Increased the chance to loot equipment instead of resources.

[b][u]Rarity of Looted Items:[/u][/b]
Slightly elevated the chance to loot items with higher rarity (based on level, difficulty, and chest type).

[b][u]Crafting System Enhancement:[/u][/b]
Implemented a new system that complements the blacksmith skill in determining crafting outcomes.
Crafting an item below the highest possible rarity for the material increases the chance for the next crafted item. For instance, with Silver items capped at "rare," each non-rare item crafted boosts the chance of getting a rare item. The chance resets upon obtaining a rare item.

[b][u]Rework of Item Creation System for Crafting and Looting:[/u][/b]
Addressed confusion around the abundance of items below the starter weapon rarity. The system has been refined to better differentiate between item rarities.

So is there still RNG? Yes, the game was built around it and I think it's great to have some of it to make it more interesting but I hope this update enables more players to find enjoyment. Your suggestions and feedback are highly welcome, and you can join the discussion on our Discord channel: https://discord.gg/MHsea9A


--------------------------------------------

Full patch notes:
[list]
[*] Overhauled the item generation system and boosted the stats of crafted and looted weapons across all rarities.
[*] Implemented the display of rarity text in the result box within the crafting window when an item is crafted.
[*] Enhanced the likelihood of equipment loot, including weapons, armor, and rings.
[*] Elevated the probability of obtaining items with higher rarity, particularly at higher levels and difficulties.
[*] Introduced a crafting rarity system that augments the likelihood of obtaining the highest possible rarity of the material with each crafted item that falls short.
[*] Bugfix: Corrected the horizontal positioning of crafting particles, which had been misaligned since the last update.
[*] Bugfix: The item name now wraps to the next line when it exceeds the space available in the result box of the crafting window.
[/list]

[*] Revised the text in the shop window to enhance clarity and understanding.
[*] Soulpower level-ups now completely refill Stamina.

notes.title: Soulknight Survivor v.1.036
notes.content:

notes.title: Development News
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44172758/1487941cbcec0f7d3aba28178263e24828650231.png[/img]

[h1]Hey everyone,[/h1]

In this post, I want to keep you up to date and show you some progress in what has been done in the last few weeks and the ongoing development.


[h2]Release Date[/h2]
The release of Soulknight Survivor is now set for December 2023. There’s still work to do, in and out of the game. But I'm optimistic about being able to release it in early December.


[h2]New name[/h2]
The name was changed from Soulknight to Soulknight Survivor. On the one hand, this is to avoid confusion with an already existing smartphone game, but I also think the new name better reflects the genre of the game.


[h2]Playtest and Feedback[/h2]
Feedback is really important for development, and I need to admit that there is currently not enough of it to make sound decisions. Any feedback is welcome, so feel free to join the discord and let me know your thoughts about the game. I also opened up a way for anyone to opt in for the playtest. Simply visit the game's [url=https://discord.gg/MHsea9A]Discord[/url] and write a message in the playtest-register channel. So if you want to be one of the earliest players of the whole experience, this is your chance!

[url=https://discord.gg/MHsea9A][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44172758/758a9cd6dbb3a66b4a11e6777d9db65a20645a74.png[/img][/url]


[h2]New Capsules[/h2]
Currently, there are new capsules in the work by a professional artist. So don’t be surprised when the appearance of Soulknight Survivor suddenly changes in the coming weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44172758/04df1217ead78206476eeafcdde3fa60113aa130.png[/img]

[h2]Events[/h2]
I'm really happy to announce that Soulknight Survivor will be featured in the coming DreamHack Beyond Summer Indie Showcase on Steam on August 18–27. There will be a livestream on steam and key giveaways on discord to celebrate this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44172758/781914d7da799147147ab8e8ee72c6e15d6dab0b.png[/img]


[h2]Development[/h2]
Finally, let's take a look at the developments. While I'm currently shifting the focus to finishing all levels and bug fixing, there have also been several new features added since the demo was released.

[b]Farm spots:[/b] Farm spots are levels where no enemies respawn. They are perfect if you just want to gather some resources in a more relaxed environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44172758/7a7aa397acf9754b6313911038ec0e751443d6ae.png[/img]

[b]Hero appearance:[/b] Every 15 levels, the hero is now evolving slightly in appearance to reflect his way of becoming the Soulknight.

[b]Improved Effects and Sounds:[/b] Several visual and sound effects were added and improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44172758/cde19d8482dd18df8aae934bd3d27ec4d2e7f56d.png[/img]

And of course there were also a lot of bugfixes and other improvements...

So that's it for the moment. If you like Soulknight Survivor and want to support it, simply wishlist and join the discord or follow on twitter/X. Thank you for your support!

I wish you a wonderful week.


[url=https://discord.gg/MHsea9A]Discord[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/SE_Develop]Twitter/X[/url]
